[[Nifling the Chained]] is an [[undead]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Varajar Fells]].

== Locations ==
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Varajar Fells}} (not during [[The Path to Revelations]] and [[A Good Deed.]])

== Skills ==
16 [[Smiting Prayers]]
* {{skill icon|Bane Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Draw Conditions}}
* {{skill icon|Infuse Health}}
* {{skill icon|Reversal of Fortune}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bone]]
* [[Nifling's Staff]] ([[unique]])
* [[Undead Bone]]

== Notes ==
* This boss is part of a large group of [[Skeleton]]s, who appear friendly at first and are in turn surrounded by hostile [[Crypt Slasher]]s. However, if you approach too closely, they all turn hostile. It is possible to [[pull]] them as separate [[mob]]s. Nifling himself is not part of any mob.

== Trivia ==
* Unlike the other bosses in Varajar Fells, it does not have an [[elite skill]].
